name: whatsapp-md-controller
description: Secure single-admin WhatsApp Web companion dashboard powered by Baileys.

scripts.dev: node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others-on-fail -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace backend && npm run prisma:db:push --workspace backend
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['backend/dist','frontend/.next']) fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})"
